summary: Inspected retained screenshots and runtime measurements at 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 390 and 375 px. Fonts were ready at every width and form/accordion controls remain visible. Reported document overflow is 0 px at 1440-390 and 1 px at 375. At 768 px and below, the expanded vacancy body is positioned outside its card content inset and visibly clips initial letters.
issues: RESP-CAR-001 | priority: high | property: expanded vacancy mobile content inset | expected: body text remains inside the accordion card that starts at x=20, with a readable inner padding | actual: at 768, 390 and 375 px the body text block starts at x=6 (widths 756, 378 and 363 respectively), visibly clipping the first letters of Lokalizacja, Stanowisko, Wymiar and subsequent headings | fix: remove the negative/full-viewport mobile width offset and constrain the open panel body to the card's inner width/padding.

RESP-CAR-002 | priority: low | property: horizontal document overflow at minimum retained width | expected: 0 px overflow at 375 px | actual: the retained runtime measurement reports overflow=1 | fix: identify the one-pixel wide overflowing border/box and constrain it to the viewport without masking content globally.
